## Weekly Report Generator

Runs every Friday at 5pm, pulls KPIs from Google Sheets, calculates metrics, asks Claude AI to write an executive narrative, and emails a branded HTML report.

**Credentials needed:**
- Google Sheets OAuth2
- Header Auth (Anthropic API key)
- Gmail OAuth2

meta.description: Automated weekly sales KPI report with AI narrative, delivered every Friday via email
